title: {p} & {v} Island Curry
steps: Season the {p} with the {spice} and brown in a heavy pot, then set aside on a clean plate.
Soften the {v} in the same pot, then add the {sauce} and enough water to half-cover.
Return the {p}, cover and simmer 30 to 40 minutes, until tender and {doneness}.
tip: Use more veg than meat, light coconut milk and plenty of thyme and ginger for flavor.
